research_question: Do source-frozen local Osirian body-member predictions predict a higher-than-chance rate of member-specific material operations in independently coded archaeological assemblages from the same localities?

epistemic_problem.discovery_contamination: The current eleven-site operator matrix was built after archaeological outcomes at those sites had already been inspected. Those sites therefore cannot serve as clean confirmatory evidence for the primary prospective test.
epistemic_problem.consequence: All currently studied sites are DISCOVERY/CALIBRATION only. Confirmatory inference must use held-out localities whose archaeological outcome corpus has not been inspected for this hypothesis after the textual prediction freeze.

textual_prediction_model.primary_recension: Dendera 42-nome Osirian relic procession / geographical theology
replication_recensions: Papyrus Jumilhac local 12/14-member traditions, analyzed separately and never merged into the Dendera primary map
textual_prediction_model.reason_for_source_separation: Late sources multiply and duplicate relics and may assign more than one member to a locality. A single harmonized modern map would create researcher degrees of freedom.
textual_prediction_model.formal_definition: For locality i, P_i is the frozen set of member classes explicitly assigned by the chosen textual recension. Do not force one member when a source assigns several, and do not import assignments from a different recension.
textual_prediction_model.secondary_sources_policy: Beinlich 1984, Coulon 2005, Mohamed 2017 and later scholarship may locate primary passages but may not define the confirmatory P_i unless the primary text/facsimile/edition is frozen.

anatomical_matching_rules.side_rule: LEFT/RIGHT is retained as metadata but collapsed for the primary test unless the textual source and archaeological outcome both preserve side with confidence >= HIGH; side-specific analysis is secondary.
anatomical_matching_rules.plural_rule: Plural and singular map to the same canonical class for primary scoring.
forbidden_primary_collapses: SPINE_BACK != DJED automatically unless the archaeological object itself is explicitly body-axis/djed class
anatomical_matching_rules.secondary_family_match: A predeclared broad anatomical-family score may be reported only as secondary sensitivity analysis.

outcome_coding.blinding: Archaeological coders must receive site/object records with the textual predicted-member field masked. Prediction table is joined only after archaeological coding is frozen.
outcome_coding.eligible_event_definition: A source-bound Osirian archaeological event/object with (a) locality attribution, (b) at least one material operator from the frozen vocabulary, and (c) member-specific morphology, inscription, container role or securely published interpretation sufficient to assign a canonical member class.
exclude: generic Osiris statuettes with no member-specific operation
objects known only from modern iconographic resemblance
textual predictions re-entering as archaeological outcomes
duplicate publications of the same object/event

passport_grade.G1: published object without stable individual context/passport; secondary only
passport_grade.G2: stable museum/excavation identifier or source-bound archival context; primary eligible
passport_grade.G3: G2 plus secure find context and/or analytical/imaging/primary register support

primary_endpoint.site_hit_definition: H_i = 1 if locality i contains at least one G2/G3 eligible archaeological event whose member class belongs to frozen P_i and whose record contains at least one admissible material operator; otherwise H_i = 0 when archaeological coverage is adequate; H_i = NA when coverage is inadequate.
primary_endpoint.statistic: T = SUM(H_i) across confirmatory localities with adequate coverage.
primary_endpoint.reason: Prevents a large cache at one site from dominating many sparsely documented localities.

archaeological_coverage_gate.C0: No usable archaeological corpus; site is NA.
archaeological_coverage_gate.C1: Very sparse or unsystematic corpus; site is NA for primary endpoint.
archaeological_coverage_gate.C2: At least one bounded excavation/museum corpus sufficient to detect multiple Osirian object classes; primary eligible.
archaeological_coverage_gate.C3: Systematic excavation/publication or well-bounded museum corpus with context/passport coverage; primary eligible.
archaeological_coverage_gate.rule: Coverage grade is frozen before unmasking P_i.

null_model.permutation_unit: Frozen P_i sets are permuted among eligible localities.
strata: broad chronological availability band where needed
preserve: global frequency of each member label
null_model.repetitions: 100000 minimum, or exact enumeration when feasible
null_model.p_value: p = (1 + permutations with T_perm >= T_obs) / (1 + number_of_permutations)

effect_size.primary: Delta_hit = observed locality hit-rate minus median permutation-null hit-rate.
effect_size.survival_gate: Primary confirmatory signal requires p <= 0.05 AND Delta_hit >= 0.20. If either condition fails, the broad causal member-bias hypothesis is not promoted.
effect_size.small_n_caution: If fewer than 10 eligible held-out localities survive coverage gating, the run is classified UNDERPOWERED and no strong causal promotion is allowed even if nominal p <= 0.05.

secondary_endpoints.definition: For each locality, x_i/N_i = member-matching eligible operator events / all member-specific eligible operator events; average equally across localities.
secondary_endpoints.inference: Permutation confidence/sensitivity only; not a second promotion gate.

secondary_endpoints.definition: Repeat descriptive match rates separately for MANUFACTURE, REPAIR, CONTAIN, PROTECT, DEPOSIT/RENEW.
Left/right match where both text and archaeology independently preserve side.

falsification_conditions: Observed T is not above the stratified permutation null.
Effect disappears when G1 records are excluded and only G2/G3 remain.
Effect is carried entirely by one locality or one repeated object publication.
Broad family matches appear but exact canonical member matches do not.
Result vanishes after deduplicating textual recensions or archaeological objects.
Match rate is equally high after randomly shifting predictions to neighboring nomes.

negative_controls.test: Shift each P_i to an adjacent nome where geography permits; true local specificity should weaken.
Generic whole-body Osiris objects should not count as member-specific success.
Where feasible, matched cult assemblages of other gods are coded for similar repair/container/body-part biases.

negative_controls.role: Demonstrates that real human tissue in an Osirian-received monument is insufficient for Osiris identity.

provisional_textual_predictions_already_.source_note: Late Osirian relic lists/Dendera-Brooklyn tradition already used in project.
Published temple-study tradition already recovered in project.
Abaton left-leg tradition already used in project.
Chester Beatty VIII/local tradition already used in project; must remain recension-specific.

full_42_nome_freeze_gate.pass_condition: Extract every nome/member assignment from one frozen Dendera recension/edition into a 42-row source table with page/line/scene references before any confirmatory archaeological lookup.
full_42_nome_freeze_gate.no_merge_rule: Conflicting Edfu/Jumilhac/other assignments are stored in separate prediction maps and used only for replication/sensitivity.
full_42_nome_freeze_gate.missing_member_rule: If a nome's member cannot be read/verified from the frozen source, mark UNKNOWN; never infer from neighboring nomes or later secondary summaries.

source_ledger.source: Verly, Auenmüller, Delvaux & Rademakers, BIFAO 122, 'Re-Membering Osiris'
source_ledger.role: Confirms Late Period 42-nome relic concept, multiplication/duplication of members, and identifies Edfu/Dendera as principal pharaonic geographical sources.
Major critical study; must be treated as interpretive scholarship and source locator, not silently as a primary recension.

source_ledger.source: Laurent Coulon, Les reliques d'Osiris en Egypte ancienne
source_ledger.role: Modern synthesis emphasizing 42-nome geopolitical remembrement, duplicated relics, and non-uniqueness.

source_ledger.source: Ayman Mohamed 2017, The body parts of Osiris: A study regarding its whereabouts
source_ledger.role: Modern location survey; locator/replication aid, not primary prediction authority.
